title: AN ORDINANCE PROHIBITING THE OPERATION OF CASINO AND PROVIDING PENALTY FOR VIOLATION THEREFOR

sections.heading: PROHIBITION OF CASINO OPERATIONS (ORD. 3375-93)
sections.text: The operation of gambling CASINO in the City of Cagayan de Oro is hereby prohibited.

sections.heading: PENALTIES AND SANCTIONS (ORD. 3375-93)
EFFECTIVITY (ORD. 3375-93)
sections.text: This Ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after its publication in a local newspaper of general circulation.

sections.heading: PROHIBITION ON BUSINESS PERMITS FOR CASINO (ORD. 3353)
sections.text: That pursuant to the policy of the city banning the operation of casino within its territorial jurisdiction, no business permit shall be issued to any person, partnership or corporation for the operation of casino within the city limits.

sections.heading: REVOCATION AND PREMISES PROHIBITION (ORD. 3353)
sections.text: That it shall be a violation of existing business permit by any persons, partnership or corporation to use its business establishment or portion thereof, or allow the use thereof by others for casino operation and other gambling activities.

sections.heading: PENALTIES ON ESTABLISHMENT PERMITS (ORD. 3353)
EFFECTIVITY (ORD. 3353)
sections.text: This Ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days from publication thereof.
